expected_behaviors: Uses ArcGisMapServerImageryProvider.fromUrl or equivalent ArcGIS URL-based path

preflight.visual_expectations: A street-map style rendering of Washington, DC with the Potomac River and central city street network visible.

prompt: Create a CesiumJS viewer that uses an ArcGIS World Street Map imagery source as the explicit base layer, with `baseLayer: false` or no default ion imagery loaded first. Position the camera over Washington, DC. The result should show a recognizable street-map style view around the National Mall and downtown area, not satellite imagery.
